title: Close fixed-bank recursion for the literal complete-row caller
body:
PR5134 completes one row-split/child/rejoin node but leaves recursive outer-port allocation open. This package reuses those exact router and parking programs across arbitrary dyadic depth on nine physical tapes. It parks each borrowed parent source and saves one active-child bit on a continuation tape; descendants reuse the same ports, without fresh tapes or a host recursion stack.

For V=B·2^d bits with a supplied positive unary B guide, the written induction preserves root SOURCE/GUIDE and arbitrary parking ancestors, restores heads, erases owned work, and returns a distinct OUTPUT. The default literal leaf has total cost at most 100Vd+264V+3 global transitions and retained allocation at most K0+16V+32, including erased backing and all source/continuation transfers. Replacement finite leaf programs retain explicit semantic, locality and uniform-resource contracts.

Validation: registered Python3.12 normal/optimized checks pass168 fixtures and7 controls, including all24 columns at depth3, independently translated origins, a first-bit-dependent row leaf, actual wrong-return/cleanup mutants and runtime tape-allocation prohibition. Committed-byte/source-history checks and22-file official export pass. Git-free normal/optimized replay passes; declared-source corruption, missing SOURCES/RESULT files, and an equal-value integer→float receipt mutation reject. Independent review caught and corrected the missing-file bypass before publication; scheduler and proof were unchanged.

Scope is a fixed-bank recursive scheduler with supplied descriptors and leaf contracts. No multiplier leaf, external descriptor conversion, nondyadic shape grammar, selected GL64 admission, Lean/kernel verification or new kappa is claimed. The finite checks support the written all-depth proof; they do not replace it.

Credit commdata2338's recursive parking, the retained Lean push/pop authors, and the PR5134/row-Builder lineage. Exact predecessors and notices remain unchanged. JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; independent agent review is distinct from human or kernel acceptance.
